purpose.summary: LGAPDB01 is a CICS-hosted subprogram that adds (inserts) a new insurance policy record to a DB2 database. It handles multiple policy types (Endowment, House, Motor, Commercial, Claim) by inserting rows into the POLICY table and the appropriate type-specific table, then links to LGAPVS01 for further processing.
